copy_samples.text: YU 수강 플래너
copy_samples.where: page.tsx nav h1; help h1 'YU 수강 플래너 사용 가이드'
copy_samples.note: Canonical product name: Latin 'YU' + space + '수강 플래너' (space between 수강 and 플래너). Shortened to '수강 플래너' in help prose and just '플래너' in nav verbs (플래너로 이동 / 플래너로 돌아가기). No 'YU플래너' form in these files.

copy_samples.text: 영남대학교
copy_samples.where: page.tsx logo alt; hero '영남대학교 생활을'; help '영남대학교 포털에서…'
copy_samples.note: Full university name in Korean; 'YU' only as brand prefix / English slogan.

copy_samples.text: YU the Future
copy_samples.note: English slogan, title case, no punctuation.

copy_samples.text: 스마트하게 설계하다. / 직관적으로 관리하다. / 아름답게 기록하다.
copy_samples.note: Literary plain-form 하다 declaratives WITH periods; the only place this register appears. Adverb + verb pattern.

copy_samples.text: 1학년부터 졸업까지, 수강 계획을 한눈에 세우세요. 다른 사람들의 수강 이력을 참고하고, 나만의 졸업 로드맵을 완성하세요.
copy_samples.note: Marketing register = 하세요체 imperatives, full periods, '나만의' first-person framing. '한눈에' recurs 4x across landing/help.

copy_samples.text: 바로 시작하기 / 비회원으로 체험하기
copy_samples.where: page.tsx CTAs (both hero and footer CTA)
copy_samples.note: Buttons use -기 nominalized verbs, never periods. '바로' (right away) is a favorite intensifier.

copy_samples.text: 비회원은 데이터가 저장되지 않습니다
copy_samples.note: 합니다체 statement, NO period. Guest = '비회원', member = '회원'.

copy_samples.text: 서비스 소개 / 이용 방법 / 시작하기 / 로그인 / 플래너로 이동
copy_samples.note: Nav labels: 2-4 word noun phrases or -기 form.

copy_samples.text: SERVICE / HOW IT WORKS
copy_samples.note: English ALL-CAPS eyebrows with tracking-[0.2em]; third eyebrow switches to Korean '지금이 가장 빠릅니다' (합니다체, no period) while keeping the uppercase class.

copy_samples.text: 왜 YU 수강 플래너인가요?
copy_samples.note: Only question-form headline; 해요체 + question mark.

copy_samples.text: 학생들의 수강 계획을 체계적으로 관리할 수 있는 핵심 기능들
copy_samples.note: Noun-phrase ending (기능들), no period; subtitles under h2 omit periods.

copy_samples.text: 드래그앤드롭 플래너 / 졸업 요건 추적 / 다른 사람들의 수강 계획 참고 / 통계 기반 의사결정
copy_samples.note: Feature titles are noun phrases. '드래그앤드롭' written as one word, no hyphen.

copy_samples.text: 마우스 하나로 과목을 원하는 학기에 끌어놓기만 하면 됩니다.
copy_samples.note: Mixes 하세요 imperative sentence followed by 됩니다 explanatory sentence in same paragraph.

copy_samples.text: 전공필수, 교양, 자유선택 등 모든 졸업 요건을 한눈에 확인하세요.
copy_samples.note: Category vocabulary surfaced in marketing: 전공필수, 교양, 자유선택.

copy_samples.text: 이렇게 사용하세요 / 3단계로 간단하게 나만의 수강 계획을 완성하세요
copy_samples.note: h2 하세요 no period; sub also no period. Numerals Arabic ('3단계').

copy_samples.text: 가입 / 계획 / 완성
copy_samples.note: Two-syllable Sino-Korean nouns as step names, numbered 01/02/03.

copy_samples.text: 구글 계정으로 간편하게 가입하거나, 비회원으로 바로 체험해보세요.
copy_samples.note: '구글' transliterated here, but help page writes 'Google 로그인' in Latin — inconsistent.

copy_samples.text: 수강 계획을 시작하세요 / 체계적인 수강 계획으로 졸업까지의 여정을 한눈에 관리하세요. / 가입 없이 바로 체험 가능
copy_samples.note: Footnote '가입 없이 바로 체험 가능' is a terse noun-ending fragment.

copy_samples.text: 수강 계획
copy_samples.note: App page title = 2 words with space; landing uses same phrase as the core object.

copy_samples.text: 학과를 설정해주세요
copy_samples.where: planner header link when no department
copy_samples.note: 해주세요 request, no period (vs onboarding validation '학과를 선택해주세요.' with period).

copy_samples.text: 학기를 클릭하여 포커스 후, 과목 리스트에서 과목을 추가하세요.

oddities: VOICE: Three registers coexist — marketing landing = 하세요체 imperatives with periods; app helper/validation = 해주세요/하세요 (periods inconsistent); help prose and toasts = 합니다체; onboarding sub-line '몇 가지 정보만 입력하면 바로 시작할 수 있어요' is the lone 해요체 string. Hero typing words use literary plain 하다 with periods.

PUNCTUATION: Periods are inconsistent on same-role strings: onboarding validation '학과를 선택해주세요.' has a period but priorCredits.ts validation '…이하여야 합니다' does not; help numbered steps '…추가합니다' have no period while help paragraphs do; '학과를 설정해주세요' (planner) vs '학과를 선택해주세요.' (onboarding). Buttons never carry periods (consistent). No exclamation marks anywhere. No emoji anywhere; typographic glyphs are used instead: '·' middot, '↔', '→', '└', '✓', '•', '+'.
SPELLING: '졸업 요건' (spaced: planner, onboarding, RequirementsSummary title) vs '졸업요건' (unspaced: help h2s, help prose, RequirementsSummary error, image alts).
SPELLING: '입학연도' (onboarding label + validation) vs '입학년도' (help section 5).
MIXING: '구글 계정' (landing, transliterated) vs 'Google 로그인' (help, Latin). Other Latin tokens: YU, PNG, PDF, SERVICE, HOW IT WORKS, 'YU the Future', 'N/A', 'Unknown Course', 'Loading...'.

STATUS VOCAB DRIFT: planned/enrolled/completed/failed rendered as 계획/수강중/완료/재수강 (full CourseCard), 예정/수강중/이수/재수강 (compact pill), 예정/이수 중/이수 완료 (help prose), and 이수/수강중/예정/미계획 (RequirementsSummary legend). aria-label uses 계획 while the visible pill reads 예정.
CATEGORY KEY/LABEL CROSS: major_required -> '전공핵심' and major_compulsory -> '전공필수'; onboarding hint under '전공핵심 (최소)' says '전공필수 최소 이수학점', and toast secondRowLabel calls major_required '전공핵심'.
LOAD-ERROR PHRASING: '계획을 불러오는데 실패했습니다.' (planner) vs '졸업요건 정보를 불러오지 못했습니다.' (RequirementsSummary) vs '저장에 실패했습니다.' — two verbs for failure.
SEMESTER FORMAT: UI uses '{year}학년 {1|2}학기' (academic-year based), while droppable ids and types use english 'spring'/'fall'. No calendar-year format like '2026-1학기' in these files.
GRAY vs SLATE: help/page.tsx uses slate-50/100/200/500/600/700 exclusively; every other file uses gray-*. help also orders size classes h-N w-N whereas the rest write w-N h-N.
UPPERCASE ON HANGUL: 'uppercase tracking-widest' applied to Korean eyebrow '지금이 가장 빠릅니다' and 'uppercase tracking-wide' on '{year}학년' heading — no visual effect on Hangul.

OFF-BRAND HEX: #0a1e3d, #1a2f5a, #0f2847 (hero/flow gradient navies), #1a4a8f (help CTA hover), #f0f7ff and #e8f4fd (CTA section gradient), inline #93c5fd/#dbeafe stripes (hard-coded Tailwind blue-300/blue-100 values) — none of these are the brand trio #153974/#3069B3/#00AACA.

SECONDARY-MAJOR COLOR DRIFT: double major is purple-100/700 chips but purple-500 solid toggle; minor is orange-100/700 chips but orange-500 toggle; the orange-100/700 pair is ALSO the major_elective category chip color, so '부전공' tag and '전공선택' tag look identical.

ENROLLED/COMPLETED HUE DRIFT: enrolled = green-50 card, green-100 pill, but sky-400 bar segment; completed = gray-50 card but emerald-100 pill and emerald-500 bar segment. planned = bg-[#153974]/5 card, blue-100 pill, blue stripe bar.

TINY TYPE: text-[9px] (status pill), text-[10px] (tags, credits, hint, year badge), text-[11px] (legend, filter label) paired with text-gray-400 — likely under 4.5:1 contrast at those sizes. Also text-white/40 notice on navy hero.
SPINNER COLORS: page spinner border-[#3069B3] vs button spinner border-gray-600.
NATIVE DIALOG: destructive reset uses window.confirm('모든 학기와 과목이 삭제됩니다. 계획을 초기화하시겠습니까?') instead of a styled modal.
ENGLISH LEAKS: 'N/A', 'Unknown Course', 'Loading...' placeholders can render inside Korean course cards.

LITERAL GLYPHS AS ICONS: help list items hard-code '• ' bullets in li text; help guide link appends ' →' in text while sibling links use ExternalLink icon; toggles prefix '+ ' as text; RequirementsSummary prefixes '✓ ' and '└ '.
HELP TERMS vs UI: help says '카탈로그 영역', '+ 버튼', 'X 버튼', '연필 아이콘' — UI has no visible '카탈로그' label in these files (planner helper says '과목 리스트').
ONBOARDING NAME: page h1 '초기 설정' but help alt text calls it '온보딩 화면'.
LOGIC ON LABEL: CourseCard compares departmentLabel === '복수전공' / '부전공' (Korean display string) to choose colors.

README: untouched create-next-app boilerplate in English (Geist font, 'edit app/page.tsx') plus MongoDB transaction notes; no product name, no Korean, no brand voice. CLAUDE.md says Next.js 15 while sweep brief says 16.
DASHBOARD: /dashboard is a bare redirect to /planner — no dashboard copy exists.
HERO SLOGAN: English 'YU the Future' badge sits above Korean headline; eyebrows SERVICE / HOW IT WORKS English but third eyebrow Korean.
DEFAULT NUMBERS: onboarding defaults 120/30/63/24 (single), 36/12 (double), 21/9/0 (minor); requirement year select hard-coded to 2025/2026.
MODULE-LEVEL UI STATE: CourseCard statusHintShown is a module variable, so pulse hint shows once per page load across all cards.
